description: Commit-bound record of real native CI/device evidence, promoted here only by .github/workflows/promote-native-evidence.yml opening a reviewed PR after a passing native-smoke.yml run on main — never hand-authored. capabilities/native-evidence.js reads verified:true entries to compute a per-platform, per-tier claim (see NATIVE_EVIDENCE_TIERS there: source-conformance < simulator-smoke < platform-verified < real-device-verified). A run only advances the claim for the platform and tier it actually earned — one passing run never flips every platform to a single blanket status. Entry shape: { sha, platform (react-native|swiftui|compose|flutter), tier, verified, runId, runUrl, date, notes }.
